track.title: Gusheh-e Moshtarak 21: Suz-o Godaz
track.notes: A gushe shared by several dastgah-ha (gusheh-ye moshtarak); the album does not say which dastgah it is played in here. In his radif albums Alizadeh plays Suz-o Godaz in Bayat-e Esfahan, Homayoun. Its tonic is its own voted finalis.

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on Db3 and dwells most on A in Suz-o Godaz. The line peaks at C5 (517.5 Hz) at 0:30.7. It closes on the tonic (A3 → A3 → C5 → A2 → A2 → A4).

theory_fit.name: Vaziri 24-tone equal temperament
theory_fit.description: Quarter-tone grid (koron/sori = exactly 50 ¢ from the natural note).

theory_fit.name: Pythagorean / Safi al-Din
theory_fit.description: Nearest note of the 17-note gamut generated by pure fifths (±8) from the tonic.
